about: fk-weather's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk3-edit-reenters
mutants.rule: An edit keeps the entry, so typing during a fetch does not restart it (law EditOnlyChangesTheDraft; a fold cannot see it).

mutants.name: fk3-submit-while-loading-reasks
mutants.rule: A submit while a fetch is under way is ignored (law ReadyShowsLatestAsk).

mutants.name: fk3-empty-draft-fetches
mutants.rule: A submit of an empty draft fails with NoZip and starts no fetch.

mutants.name: fk3-ask-untrimmed
mutants.rule: The ask is the trimmed draft.

mutants.name: fk3-failure-shows-nozip
mutants.from:
case (Loading, Unavailable as u):
		show(l, Failed{Why: u})
mutants.rule: A forecast that cannot answer shows why: Unavailable, with its reason.

mutants.name: fk3-no-work
mutants.rule: Loading's entry owns the fetch: with no work, no answer ever comes (the cases' script waits for it).

mutants.name: fk3-memory-notfound-zip
mutants.rule: A zip with no place is refused with that zip (law Forecast.NotFoundNamesTheZip for Stations).

mutants.name: fk3-web-asks-no-name
mutants.rule: The geocoding ask names the zip (test FetchGivesTheReport: the fixture knows only name=90210).

mutants.name: fk3-web-round-down
mutants.rule: Temperature and wind are rounded to the nearest integer, as upstream's Math.round: 9.8 mph shows 10 (test FetchGivesTheReport).

mutants.name: fk3-web-404-unavailable
mutants.rule: A geocoding answer that is not 200 is NotFound, as upstream's "Location not found" (test HTTPFailureFails).

mutants.name: fk3-web-no-results-unavailable
mutants.rule: A geocoding answer with no place is NotFound (test NoPlaceIsNotFound).

mutants.name: fk3-web-no-results-loses-zip
mutants.rule: OpenMeteo keeps the Forecast contract: NotFound names the zip (property ContractHoldsOverTheFixture).

mutants.name: fk3-busy-never
mutants.rule: A lookup in Loading waits for its fetch (test SubmitFetchesAndShowsTheReport; the cases' script then shows no answer).
